subject: Compliance intake — SOC 2 / DPA / pen test scheduling
messages:
From: Maya Sanders <maya.sanders@bluepeak.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request to schedule SOC 2 / DPA review + pen test intake

Hi Jonas,

We are kicking off our vendor assessment for BluePeak's upcoming SOC 2 vendor review and need to schedule a walkthrough with Redwood's security/compliance team. Primary goals: confirm DPA terms, review retention/data flow, and discuss the pen test intake process and timelines.

Are you available for a 60-minute sync next week? Our security folks are on Pacific time but we also have team members in GMT (UK) and IST — ideally we find an overlap that works for everyone.

High-level constraints:
- Preferred window: Nov 17–19, mornings PT
- Need to include a technical engineer for the pen-test intake step
- We have a short questionnaire that we'd like to review live (I can send it before the call)

Thanks — happy to be flexible on times if you propose a few options.

Regards,
Maya Sanders
Sr. Security Program Manager | BluePeak Analytics
(attachment: vendor-questionnaire.xlsx)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Sanders <maya.sanders@bluepeak.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule SOC 2 / DPA review + pen test intake

Thanks for the note, Maya — glad to coordinate.

Quick answers up front: we can cover DPA language and evidence collection in the same session; we recommend a 60-minute slot to leave time for the questionnaire and Q&A. Karthik (our security lead) will join and Marissa (CS) will help with logistics.

Proposed options (all PT):
- Wed 2026-11-17 09:30–10:30 PT
- Thu 2026-11-18 08:00–09:00 PT (early AM slot for UK overlap)
- Fri 2026-11-19 11:00–12:00 PT

I attached our internal evidence checklist and the pen-test SLAs so your team can skim before we meet. If none of these work, tell us 2–3 preferred windows and we'll adapt.

(attachment: redwood-compliance-evidence-checklist.pdf) (attachment: pen-test-sla.pdf)

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Maya Sanders <maya.sanders@bluepeak.io>

Cc: BluePeak Security Team <security@bluepeak.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 07:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule SOC 2 / DPA review + pen test intake

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the options. A couple of notes from our side:
- The early Thu 08:00 PT slot is actually tough for our US program lead (in EST) due to an all-hands.
- The Fri 11:00 PT slot would be very close to a customer demo we have; we prefer Wed 09:30 if Karthik and an engineer can join.

Also, can Karthik confirm whether the pen-test scope doc is required before the call or if a high-level intake is sufficient? Our pen-test vendor prefers to see scope statements before booking but can accept a follow-up.

If Wed 09:30 works, please send an invite with a dial-in and include any pre-read links.

On vendor-questionnaire.xlsx: I'll upload our answers to the file and send it back by Monday.

—Maya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Sanders <maya.sanders@bluepeak.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule SOC 2 / DPA review + pen test intake

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 07:18, Maya Sanders <maya.sanders@bluepeak.io> wrote:
> Thanks Jonas — appreciate the options. A couple of notes from our side:
> - The early Thu 08:00 PT slot is actually tough for our US program lead (in EST) due to an all-hands.
> - The Fri 11:00 PT slot would be very close to a customer demo we have; we prefer Wed 09:30 if Karthik and an engineer can join.

Hi Maya — Karthik here (security ops). Wed 11/17 09:30 PT works for me. I will bring our pen-test intake engineer (R&D security lead) and we can do a 75-minute block if you anticipate detailed questions.

About scope: a high-level scope is fine for the intake call (systems, data domains, and whether customer data is processed). If the vendor needs a detailed scope to schedule the test, we typically follow up after the intake with a short scope doc and timeline.

I'll set the calendar for 75 minutes to avoid rushing and attach a short agenda: 1) introductions 2) DPA points 3) pen-test intake checklist 4) questionnaire review 5) Q&A.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Invite includes: dial-in, Teams link, and the agenda Karthik mentioned. Pre-reads: redwood-compliance-evidence-checklist.pdf and pen-test-sla.pdf (attached). Maya, if you can share the vendor-questionnaire.xlsx answers as you mentioned, we'll slot time in the agenda to go through them.

If anything changes, I'll coordinate an alternative — otherwise look forward to the sync.

Jonas
